actions_performed: Traced the live repository repair path from .github/workflows/barrot-agent.yml to scripts/barrot_agent.py and barrot_agent/orchestration/repository_repair.py
Confirmed the active Groq repair-planning request path previously omitted tools and therefore relied on the provider default non-tool mode
Added repo_browser.print_tree and repo_browser.search tool support to the live ScriptBrain Groq request loop
Ensured tool-capable Groq requests send tool_choice=auto and non-tool requests omit tool_choice
Added safe repo-browser argument validation for empty and escaping paths
Extended RepositoryRepairController failure handling with BLOCKED state, durable cycle persistence, safe resume metadata, and retry-exhaustion detection
Added runtime collaboration-record emission for live repair cycles
Added and ran regression tests for tool conflicts, repo-browser tool calls, persistence, resume behavior, and retry exhaustion

tests.details: Completed with one pre-existing SyntaxWarning in barrot_agent/tools/upgrade_bundle.py

results.bundle_1: active live repair path uses RepositoryRepairController with evidence gating and NO_REPAIR_REQUIRED
results.bundle_2: durable cycle persistence, safe resume metadata, blocked-state recording, bounded retries, and unchanged-plan retry exhaustion detection are implemented
results.bundle_3: adversarial regression coverage includes invalid JSON, Groq tool conflict classification, unsafe paths, patch precondition failures, validation failure rollback, remote verification failure, duplicate repair, empty project identity handling, and retry exhaustion

evidence.tool_mode_rule: tool-capable requests attach repo_browser tools and set tool_choice=auto; plain requests omit tool_choice entirely
evidence.runtime_collaboration_record: scripts/barrot_agent.py writes .barrot/collaboration_records/latest_repository_repair.json on each live run

commits.note: Runtime repository-repair commits are recorded by RepositoryRepairController in RepairCycleEvidence.commit and emitted into live collaboration records.

remote_verification.details: Remote SHA verification remains evidence-gated in RepositoryRepairController via git push plus git ls-remote verification.
